title: Enterprise Connectivity: combined support intake
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity governs combined support intake for service charge.

## Superseded scope 1
The following ordinary clause is no longer in force within the applicable assisted routes for corrected monthly transfer assessment; assisted correction posting; assisted overpayment payout; invoice ceiling acceptance; accepted-source pricing; net transfer invoice; separate statutory tax. It remains the ordinary basis outside those specifically defined routes. Retired within that scope: A current Northbridge Enterprise Support holding for the same customer and billing entity provides assisted invoice explanation, but does not itself reduce this category price or waive debt.

## Policy clause 2
An approved negotiated rate is a contract-specific override; the presence of a paid support holding makes assisted negotiated-amendment intake available through support as well as portal and api.

## Policy clause 3
Without that combination the signed amendment is submitted through portal or api.

## Policy clause 4
A promotional primary-price entitlement is suppressed wherever a commitment price covers the same quantity, and no benefit from an unrelated category is stacked.

## Policy clause 5
The combination changes only request-channel eligibility, not approval authority.

## Points of judgement
The combination changes only request-channel eligibility, not approval authority.

## Tier references
The contract tier supplies the authorized request channels, campaign channels, price precedence used by this rule.
